scene.description: Paved surface with a white marking and a long dark linear opening or seam containing vegetation; joint versus crack is uncertain.

result.guidance: Take a closer overhead photo of the central seam, keeping both edges in focus and your shadow clear of the area.
result.reason: Focus and exposure appear adequate for an overview, but the seam needs closer evidence and human review to distinguish a joint from a crack. No physical width measurement is available.

suggestions.title: Visible cracks / joints
suggestions.reason: Proposed for your confirmation: review the linear feature using a close-up to help distinguish a possible crack from a pavement joint. Detector observations would remain unconfirmed.

suggestions.title: Periodic inspection, maintenance and defect follow-up
suggestions.reason: Proposed for your confirmation: have an inspector identify the seam, physically measure its opening and record vegetation and edge condition for comparison with maintenance records.

actions.instruction: Capture one closer overhead view of the seam with both edges sharp and unobscured.
Proposed pending your tap: have an inspector distinguish an intended joint from a crack using the close-up and available pavement details, and measure the opening with a suitable physical gauge.

scene.description: Paved-looking surface with a dark linear seam or opening, irregular edges and leafy vegetation. Joint versus crack remains uncertain.

result.guidance: For the selected mold-like appearance check, capture one closer overhead view of the dark area beside the leaves, keeping its surface texture sharp and evenly lit.
result.reason: Focus and exposure appear adequate. Visible leaves and seam darkness do not establish mold-like growth or identify mold. No detector observations are supplied; the selected experimental research-phele detector has poor recall and cannot provide fungal diagnosis.

suggestions.title: Visible cracks / joints
suggestions.reason: Alternative proposal awaiting your tap: review the linear opening; an inspector must distinguish a pavement joint from a crack.

suggestions.title: Periodic inspection, maintenance and defect follow-up
suggestions.reason: Alternative proposal awaiting your tap: record vegetation and edge condition, physically measure the opening and compare with maintenance records.

actions.instruction: Capture one closer overhead photo of the dark surface beside the leaves with sharp texture and even lighting.
Have the inspector review whether any surface growth-like appearance is distinguishable from leaves, debris and seam shadow. Retain any observation as unconfirmed; appearance cannot identify mold.
